I’d block on **one issue** in `3ebff74`:

**[P1] Team and archive accounts cannot upload anything — `src/plans.js:11`.**  
`entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s signed 32-bit bitwise arithmetic. Both paid-plan quotas become **0 bytes**, rather than 200 GiB and 2 TiB. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for both plans.

Use numeric multiplication (`entry.quotaKiB * 1024`) and add quota/upload coverage for both paid plans before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they only exercise the free-plan quota. No code changed.
